hooks.name: Flutter Quality Gate
hooks.description: When a new Flutter page or widget is created, review for design system compliance, memory safety, and accessibility.

action.prompt:
A new Dart file was created. Run this quality checklist:

DESIGN SYSTEM:
- Colors via Theme.of(context).colorScheme, not hardcoded Color(0xFF...).
- Text styles via theme.textTheme, not inline TextStyle().
- Card radius 24, button/input radius 16, button height 54.
- Spacing uses 8px grid (4/8/16/24/32) with SizedBox, not Container.
- Page padding: horizontal 20, top 16.

MEMORY SAFETY:
- StatefulWidgets dispose all controllers, timers, and subscriptions.
- setState() after async gaps guarded with 'if (!mounted) return'.
- Lists use ListView.builder (not Column with .map).

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Icons/images have semanticLabel.
- Touch targets >= 48x48.
- Color is not the sole state indicator.

PATTERNS:
- const constructors used where possible.
- Feature file stays in its own feature module (no cross-feature imports except shared/).
- Named required parameters on model constructors.

If this is a model/util file (not UI), only check naming, const, and import rules. Approve and proceed if compliant.
